 Order

This is the first application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Code of Criminal Procedure for grant of regular bail relating to FIR No.401/2022, registered at Police Station-Gunor,
District Panna (M.P.) for the offence under Sections 363, 344, 366-A, 376(2) (N), 376(3), 323,
506-II of IPC and Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act, 2012.
2. Learned counsel appearing for applicant submitted that offence was consensual.
Prosecutrix is having sufficient maturity.
Applicant is a young man.
Applicant is in jail since 01.02.2023.

In these Sonu Kumar Kori vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 21 June, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/17639879/
1 circumstances, applicant be released on bail.

sentences.text: 3. Learned Government Advocate appearing for the State opposed the application for grant of bail and submitted that offence is serious in nature.
Allegation under Section 5(L)/6 of POCSO Act is also made out against the applicant.
Applicant had committed rape on minor girl.
In these circumstances, application be dismissed.

4. Heard the counsel for the parties.
5.
Applicant is a young man aged about 19 years and prosecutrix is aged about 15 years.
In her statement she has stated that she is known to applicant and both of them are having relationship.
Investigation is complete and charge- sheet has been filed.
6. Considering the facts and circumstances of the case, bail application filed by applicant is allowed.

7. It is directed that applicant be released on bail on his furnishing personal bond of Rs.50,000/-(Rs. Fifty Thousand only) with one solvent surety in the like amount to the satisfaction of the trial court for his appearance before the trial court on the dates to be fixed by the trial court.
8. The applicant shall also abide by the conditions of Section 437 (3) of Cr. P. C. C.C. as per rules.

(VISHAL DHAGAT) JUDGE sp/-
